https://quillstack.dev/blog/quillstack-2.body:
Quillstack 2.0 is generally available

March 10, 2026

Quillstack 2.0 is now generally available. The headline feature is resumable runs: when a run stops because of a crash, a timeout or a rate limit, it continues from the last saved step instead of starting over. Resumable runs have been in beta since version 1.8 (January 2026); 2.0 makes them stable and on by default.

Important: steps that write to external systems (sending an email, calling a payment API) are not replayed automatically. Mark such steps as idempotent, or Quillstack stops and asks you to confirm.

Availability: all plans. Saved run state is kept for 24 hours on the Free plan and 30 days on Team.

Breaking change: Python 3.10 is no longer supported.

Release notes: v2.0.0

https://github.com/quillstack/quillstack.body:
Release v2.0.0 · quillstack/quillstack

v2.0.0 Latest. Released this Mar 10, 2026.

  • Resumable runs are stable and enabled by default (beta since v1.8.0).
  • New: `quillstack resume RUN_ID`.
  • Breaking: drop Python 3.10.
  • Fix: retries no longer double-count tokens.

Posted March 10, 2026 by Ana.
